reason: A DSH web interface plugin that adds a compact right-side panel for browsing conversation questions and jumping to selected messages, including older unloaded history.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加右侧对话跳转导航，通过问题列表快速定位并高亮对应消息。
summaries.en: Adds a compact right-side conversation navigator to the DSH web interface for locating and highlighting selected messages.

capabilities: Adds a right-side conversation navigation overlay to the DSH web interface
Reads persisted and active session question logs through a local HTTP endpoint
Loads older conversation pages and scrolls to selected messages with highlighting
Polls for newly added questions and tracks the current reading position
